import hashlib, json, re
from pathlib import Path
root = Path.cwd()
logs = root / "logs/v0.0.3"
baseline = json.loads((logs / "input_hashes.json").read_text())
for name, expected in baseline.items():
    actual = hashlib.sha256(Path(name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    assert actual == expected, "输入文件变化: " + name
print("PASS: 路线图、既有文档、两个相关工程配置及 elan 全局设置共", len(baseline), "个文件字节不变。")
formal = [Path("LeanPML.lean"), Path("Audit.lean"), Path("LeanPML/Tutorial/LocalEnergy.lean")]
assert sorted(str(p) for p in root.glob("*.lean")) + sorted(str(p) for p in (root / "LeanPML").rglob("*.lean")) == sorted(str(root / p) for p in formal[:2]) + [str(root / formal[2])]
for rel in formal:
    body = (root / rel).read_text()
    code = re.sub(r"/\*[\s\S]*?\*/", "", body)
    code = re.sub(r"/-[\s\S]*?-/", "", code)
    code = re.sub(r"--[^\n]*", "", code)
    assert not re.search(r"\b(sorry|admit|axiom)\b", code), str(rel)
    output = root / ".lake/build/lib/lean" / rel.with_suffix(".olean")
    assert output.is_file(), str(output)
print("PASS: 三个正式 Lean 文件均有构建产物；源码没有 sorry、admit 或 axiom 声明。")
assert "import LeanPML.Tutorial.LocalEnergy" in (root / "LeanPML.lean").read_text()
assert "#print axioms LeanPML.Tutorial.hasDerivAt_energy" in (root / "Audit.lean").read_text()
assert 'defaultTargets = ["LeanPML", "Audit"]' in (root / "lakefile.toml").read_text()
assert (root / "lean-toolchain").read_text().strip() == "leanprover/lean4:v4.31.0"
manifest = json.loads((root / "lake-manifest.json").read_text())
mathlib = next(p for p in manifest["packages"] if p["name"] == "mathlib")
assert mathlib["rev"] == "fabf563a7c95a166b8d7b6efca11c8b4dc9d911f"
assert len(manifest["packages"]) == 9
print("PASS: 默认目标、导入链、审计声明与固定版本一致。")
for stem in ["20261006T150357_739595_lake_build", "20261006T150431_846159_axioms_audit"]:
    metadata = json.loads((logs / (stem + ".json")).read_text())
    assert metadata["exit_code"] == 0 and metadata["status"] == "finished"
    assert metadata["cwd"] == str(root)
    output = (logs / (stem + ".log")).read_text()
    assert "depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]" in output
    assert "sorryAx" not in output
build = (logs / "20261006T150357_739595_lake_build.log").read_text()
for mod in ["LeanPML.Tutorial.LocalEnergy", "LeanPML", "Audit"]:
    assert "Built " + mod in build
print("PASS: 默认构建与独立审计的真实日志均退出 0，公理依赖仅为三项标准原则。")
for name in ["README.md", "PROGRESS.md"]:
    body = (root / name).read_text()
    for target in re.findall(r"\]\(([^)]+)\)", body):
        if not target.startswith(("https:", "http:", "#")):
            assert (root / target.split("#", 1)[0]).exists(), name + ": " + target
    assert len(re.findall(r"^\$\$$", body, re.M)) % 2 == 0, name
    assert len(re.findall(r"^\x60\x60\x60", body, re.M)) % 2 == 0, name
print("PASS: README 与 PROGRESS 的本地链接、数学显示块及代码块成对。")
print("FINAL: v0.0.3 验收检查全部通过；未推进 v0.1.1。")
